description: Auto-rigs a humanoid character from a prior Meshy 3D task into a GLB/FBX with optional basic walk/run animations (Meshy Rig).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

height_meters.description: Approximate height of the character model in meters. Aids scaling and rigging accuracy.

meshy_task_id.description: The task ID of a completed Meshy 3D model that needs to be rigged.
